lead.zh: 不写代码、不做开发：先知道 AI 能做什么、哪里会错，再学会安全地用聊天、搜索与生成工具。
lead.en: No code, no development: learn what AI can do and where it fails, then use chat, search and generation tools safely.

zh: 说清 AI 的回答为什么可能错，并知道至少两种核对办法
拿到一段 AI 生成的文字或图片，能判断哪些信息必须人工复核
知道哪些内容不要输入公共聊天工具，以及怎么用临时聊天或关闭训练开关
en: Explain why an AI answer can be wrong and know at least two ways to check it
Given AI-generated text or images, identify which claims need human verification
Know what not to paste into a public chat tool, and how to use temporary chat or turn off training
